**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v2/cpa2-f004-api-supply-sow.md#11-commercial-rule-cpa2-f004-r011

For campaign reservation shortfall, billability requires confirmed evidence of: sponsor forecast notice; released yield reconciliation. The base price is USD 605.89 per service unit. At 2397 aggregated units the discount is 13%. Only units strictly above the threshold receive the discount; lower units retain the base price. All facts and approvals must concern supplier CPA2-F004, the billed service ID, invoice line and January 2027 service period. A record for another item provides no confirmation for this line.

## 1. Evidence escalation

**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v2/cpa2-f004-evidence-policy.md#1-evidence-escalation

This fictional procedure applies only to supplier CPA2-F004 in January 2027. Conflicting sponsor and provider quality statuses for the same billed service item require evidence escalation and reconciliation before billability is resolved. Neither party's status automatically prevails. Unverified prerequisites require evidence review. A record identifying another supplier, invoice line or service ID cannot confirm the billed item. The controller retains all payment and business-system decisions; evidence direction is not an executed action.

## 12. Commercial rule CPA2-F010-R012

**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v2/cpa2-f010-sterilization-sow.md#12-commercial-rule-cpa2-f010-r012

For sponsor quarantine storage, billability requires confirmed evidence of: sponsor-caused quarantine; approved storage extension. The base price is USD 787.67 per service unit. At 2696 aggregated units the discount is 13%. Only units strictly above the threshold receive the discount; lower units retain the base price. All facts and approvals must concern supplier CPA2-F010, the billed service ID, invoice line and January 2027 service period. A record for another item provides no confirmation for this line.

## 1. Evidence escalation

**Source ref:** knowledge/contracts/policy-analyst-v2/cpa2-f010-evidence-policy.md#1-evidence-escalation

This fictional procedure applies only to supplier CPA2-F010 in January 2027. Conflicting sponsor and provider quality statuses for the same billed service item require evidence escalation and reconciliation before billability is resolved. Neither party's status automatically prevails. Unverified prerequisites require evidence review. A record identifying another supplier, invoice line or service ID cannot confirm the billed item. The controller retains all payment and business-system decisions; evidence direction is not an executed action.
